# CITiZAN ID: 25678 GARSTON DOCK

CoreTrustSeal Certified 

### Description 

Garston dock was constructed by the london and north western railway company, in 1853, as a rival to the mersey dock. It shipped lancashire coal to ireland, most of the loading was done by railway trucks being lifted and tipped into the ship's hold. It also imported timber and bananas. Ship breaking also took place here. The dock is now owned by associated british ports, dealing in timber, steel and containers.
